column1: # G0 is built from the PINNED ENTRY commit in a disposable
# detached worktree, with the driver selector OFF. At the pinned
# entry the driver IS the C driver, so the selector-OFF build is
# the genuine predecessor C driver, NOT a stub and NOT a script.
# It MAY retain the 15 pre-existing PolyC helper subjects: G0 is
# C-only FOR THE DRIVER, not for all compiler semantics.
